item.title: Slash Commands 1.0.3
item.description:
## What's New in 1.0.3
### Command Expansion - Restarts command expansion automatically when macOS stops listening for shortcuts while permissions are still enabled. - Keeps Slash Commands ready after long-running sessions where typing a slash command and pressing `Tab` could otherwise do nothing until restart.
### Diagnostics - Shows clearer runtime status when command expansion is temporarily stopped and expected to recover automatically. - Keeps startup failures visible as `Runtime unavailable` instead of retrying the same failed startup repeatedly.
### Updates - Improved release packaging reliability so patch updates can be prepared and delivered more consistently.
